main_inactive_warning: XPatchKernel is inactive — patches and some features are unavailable
main_manager_update_warning: Update XPatch Manager from the repository; otherwise the UI cannot expose new features.
logs_desc: Shows the last {max_lines} lines with [xpatch] from logs/kernel.log. Refresh: {interval}s.
utils_logs_desc: Live logs — live view of [xpatch] lines from logs/kernel.log. You can choose line limit and refresh interval.
utils_danger_desc: Danger zone — remove the kernel, backups, patches, and manager module. You can also choose default core and auto-restart.
remove_desc: Choose what to remove. This is irreversible for selected files. Order: kernel > backups > patches > default core > manager > restart.
settings_auto_desc: Install immediately when VERSION_XKERNEL becomes newer
settings_notify_desc: Bot writes to log chat or client DM
client_desc: Patches core.lib.base.client.TelegramClient and changes client parameters: app name, device and language.
client_restart_warn: Changes apply after MCUB restart / TelegramClient recreation.
patches_hint: Tap a patch to open details.
remove_patches_absent: ℹ️ Patches folder is already absent
extera_desc: What it does: gives selected modules access to protected XKernel objects: kernel / client / event. Use it only when a module explicitly needs a protected object, for example client session.
extera_do_not_touch: If you do not know why you need this — do not touch it.
extera_trusted_warning: Enable only for known and trusted modules. Do not enable it for unknown or suspicious modules.
extera_unsupported_scopes: Current XKernel does not support ExteraProxy scopes
extera_unsupported: Current XKernel does not support ExteraProxy
extera_all_on_answer: ExteraProxy enabled for all. Careful: trusted modules only!
experimental_hot_reload_desc: watches patches/*.py files and reloads changed patches
experimental_warning: These features are experimental: enable them only if you understand the risks.
experimental_unavailable_desc: Current kernel does not support XKernel runtime features.
stealth_unsupported: Current XKernel does not support stealth mode. Update XKernel and restart MCUB.
client_patch_unsupported: Current XKernel does not support Client Patch
client_patch_clear_hint: To clear the field, send - or clear.
patch_min_version: Minimum XKernel version for this patch: {version}
patch_version_ok: Patch is compatible with current XKernel version
patch_min_version_unknown: Minimum XKernel version is not specified for this patch
patch_reload_unsupported: This XKernel does not support single patch reload
patch_toggle_unsupported: This XKernel does not support patch enable/disable
install_default_desc: If yes, MCUB will start with XKernel without manual --core XKernel.
update_current_title: XKernel is already up to date
apply_restart_required: Restart is required to apply patches
manager_update_notice_hint: Update the module from the repository to get new UI features.
utils_rebuild_desc: Manager rebuild — creates a copy with a new module name and sends the .py file to chat.
rebuild_desc: Only string literals exactly equal to the current module name are replaced. Substrings inside longer texts are not touched.
rebuild_name_invalid: Invalid name. Use latin letters, digits and _, first char must be latin. No spaces or special symbols.
rebuild_same_name: New name must differ from the current one.
rebuild_forbidden: Rebuild is available only from the original XPatchKernelManager.
rebuild_source_missing: Manager source file was not found.
rebuild_no_replacements: No replaceable strings found. Rebuild cancelled.
rebuild_sent_delete: Rebuilt manager sent. Removing current module...
rebuild_send_failed: Failed to build or send manager
rebuild_saved_only_no_delete: File was sent to Saved Messages, but forwarding to this chat failed. Current manager was not removed.
hot_reload_retry_interval_invalid: Interval must be a number from 1 to 3600 seconds.
hot_reload_old_core_warning: Current XKernel is old and does not support advanced Hot reload settings. Update XKernel; otherwise these options are saved only in manager config.
hot_reload_settings_desc: Smart disable — if hot reload fails to load a patch, it is temporarily skipped. Retry interval — seconds before retrying a problem patch. Disable on first error — marks the patch disabled after the first hot reload error. Hot load new patches — loads new files from patches/ without restart.
hot_reload_smart_disable_desc: Smart disable — if hot reload fails to load a patch, it is temporarily skipped.
hot_reload_retry_interval_desc: Retry interval — seconds before retrying a problem patch.
hot_reload_disable_on_first_fail_desc: Disable on first error — marks the patch disabled after the first hot reload error.
hot_load_new_patches_desc: Hot load new patches — loads new files from patches/ without restart.
mcmac_desc: Mandatory Access Control for MCUB modules. Currently a safe permissive/no-op layer: enableaudit and prepare policies. in short: SELinux is for MCUB
mcmac_audit_mode_desc: all — log every checked action: who, class, action and object. denied — log only policy-denied actions with blocked/permissive marker. blocked — log only actions actually blocked in enforcing mode. off — do not store audit records.
mcmac_module_type_invalid: Format: ModuleName:trusted. Types: trusted, standard, untrusted, quarantine.
mcmac_type_system_desc: system — MCUB system modules. Full access, assigned automatically by kernel.
mcmac_type_trusted_desc: trusted — trusted modules. Allows kernel read, Telegram send/delete/admin and network; subprocess is denied.
mcmac_type_standard_desc: standard — normal local modules. Allows kernel read, Telegram send/delete, network and config db; denies admin/account/subprocess.
mcmac_type_untrusted_desc: untrusted — remote/suspicious modules. Allows only basic send; denies delete/admin/account/network/subprocess/config write/module load.
mcmac_type_quarantine_desc: quarantine — quarantine. Everything is denied, only audit/permissive log remains.
mcmac_mode_desc: permissive — audit/log only, denied actions are not blocked. enforcing — policy-denied actions are blocked with CallInsecure.
mcmac_module_type_remove_hint: To remove an override, open the list and press the module button.
mcmac_remove_module_type_desc: Choose a module to remove its MCMAC type override.
mcmac_unavailable_warning: MCMAC libs are unavailable. Download/update libs; otherwise policy settings will not be applied.
system_patch_desc: Patches MCUB system modules: man and updates.
system_patch_man_desc: Adds ExteraProxy and MCMAC module info to man.
system_patch_updates_desc: Adds XKernel core info to update.
system_patch_unsupported: Текущее XKernel ядро не поддерживает Patch system module
